name: camshield
description: CamShield – Camera Privacy Awareness & Security Monitoring Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run server" "npm run client"
